tasks.approved_by: Founder approval in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-10-30
scope: Investigate failures in configured PadippuPal CI and test workflows.
Prepare focused repairs only when they are necessary to satisfy an already-approved roadmap task's acceptance criteria.
Run the relevant regression checks and create a reviewable pull request.
non_goals: Invent or implement new product features.
Change curriculum or learner-facing behavior outside an approved task.
Merge pull requests, deploy production, write production data, perform destructive migrations, or publish releases.
acceptance_criteria: Every repair links to the originating failed workflow run and exact tested SHA.
A confirmed root cause and regression test are recorded before a repair is proposed.
No more than five distinct repair generations are attempted for one originating failure; generation five failure escalates.
All changes are isolated in branches and submitted as pull requests.
Required checks run against the exact proposed commit and no assertions are weakened or tests skipped.

scope: Finish the chapter-scoped native Compose hand-drawn interactive whiteboard for Class 6 Science: Beyond Earth.

Use native Jetpack Compose drawing primitives only; do not use SVG and do not alter other chapters.
Run relevant Android build, unit, UI smoke, backend/curriculum and chapter-specific acceptance checks; merge and deploy this change only after all required checks pass.
non_goals: Change unrelated chapters, curriculum content or voice providers.
Write or migrate production database content.
Merge unrelated PRs or publish a public APK without the explicit release workflow approval.
acceptance_criteria: All eight Beyond Earth visual subtypes render in the native hand-drawn whiteboard.
Drawing stages reveal progressively in sync with the active narrated lesson step.
Tap-to-reveal works without breaking narration-synchronized progress.
Labels remain readable on compact and full layouts.
No SVG assets or renderer are introduced.
Android build, required unit/static checks, UI smoke and relevant curriculum/API checks pass on the exact release commit.
The production APK artifact is built from the verified commit and can be installed/opened for founder inspection.
